record.editNotice: Changes apply only after you press Save changes. All times are in Japan time.
record.fullEdit: Edit type, notes and other details
record.reload: Reload the current record and discard your edits? An unconfirmed request may already have applied.

errors.load: Could not load this record. Check your connection and try again.
errors.missing: This record was not found. It may have been deleted on another screen.
errors.conflict: This record has changed. Reload its current content before editing again.
errors.notApplied: Your changes were not present when checked. Resend the same changes or close and review your records.
errors.invalidTime: Choose a time within the last 365 days that is not in the future.
errors.invalid: Check your input. Amounts must be nonnegative; durations must be nonnegative whole minutes.

timeline.title: Today's timeline
timeline.ownNotice: These are records you created. Select one to see details or make corrections.
timeline.familyNotice: Today's shared baby care records in the family you selected. Unshared records and adults' health and mood are excluded.
timeline.empty: No records to display today. Care during unrecorded periods is unknown.
timeline.readOnly: Shared family records are for viewing. Switch to My records to correct a record you created.

shortcuts.title: Choose your usual buttons
shortcuts.notice: Choose 1–4 buttons and arrange them. Only these button choices are saved for this account on this device.
shortcuts.storageError: Could not save these preferences on this device. Check your browser storage settings.

timer.title: Time breastfeeding or sleep
timer.notice: Starting and stopping do not save a care record. Review the times and duration, then save.
timer.returned: You left this screen. Check that the start and end match the activity you actually observed. An end time is never chosen automatically.
timer.rounding: Partial minutes are rounded down. Elapsed time may differ from actual feeding or sleep time.
timer.confirm: I checked the actual start, end and content to save
timer.discardConfirm: Discard this timer without saving a care record?
timer.pendingPreview: Resending the original record: {{count}} min from {{time}} (Japan time). Its content will not change.

errors.invalidTime: Check the start and end. Use times within the last 365 days, with the end at or after the start and not in the future.
errors.conflict: The record for this operation may have changed or been deleted. Review your records.
errors.draftClear: Could not delete the saved draft. Check your connection and try discarding again.
errors.notFound: No saved result was found at the time of checking. The request may still be processing; check again or resend the same content.
errors.checkFailed: Could not check the saved result. Check your connection and try again.

chat.replaceDraft: Replace your current question or change the selected previous exchange?
chat.draftNotice: An editable question draft is ready. Review and select the previous exchange if you want to include it, then review and confirm sending. Nothing has been sent yet.

drafts.shorter: Please explain the previous answer briefly in plain language, keeping its cautions.
drafts.supplement:
I would like to add some circumstances to my previous question.
What I would like to add:

handover.notice: Tell your family you have read this version. Opening the screen does not acknowledge it. This does not record that care was performed.
handover.previousReceipt: {{name}} acknowledged the earlier version {{number}}: {{time}}. The current version is not acknowledged.
handover.conflict: The note or sharing settings changed. Read the current version before acknowledging.
handover.failed: The confirmation result was not received. Reload and review acknowledgements. Retrying the same version does not change the original time.

support.notice: Start wherever useful. Preparation and progress recording are optional.
support.chooseFirst: Choose a contact to prepare your opening and organize your next step.
support.skipPreparation: Skip preparation and record a next step
support.manualProgress: Calling or opening a booking link does not mark a contact as reached. Select the actual situation and save it yourself.
support.next: Go to next step (even if you have only prepared)
support.removed: This contact is no longer listed. You can review your earlier draft and progress. Confirm contact details again.

checks.question: I organized what I want to ask
checks.documents: I checked what to bring or prepare (ask the contact about anything unknown)

weekly.title: Review this week's information one at a time
weekly.notice: Work through contacts needing review that match the maintainer filter when you start. Viewing them does not change review dates or published content.
weekly.unchanged: If you confirmed the information is unchanged
weekly.attest: I checked the listed information. Apply the displayed checked and next review dates to the draft.
weekly.editNotice: Use the editor below. Changes remain in your local draft. Edit the checked and next review dates as needed.
weekly.finishNotice: Changes have not been published. Save the draft, then preview the changes and family view before publishing. Contacts with missing fields remain on the review list.
weekly.close: Return to the editor (keep draft changes)
weekly.dateError: Choose a checked date no later than today, and a next review date after it and no earlier than today.
weekly.removed: This contact was removed from the draft.
